data_objects.name: housing_area_records
data_objects.meaning: Geographically located housing-area records with income, housing age, room, bedroom, population, occupancy, and median house-value measures.

variables.name: MedInc
variables.meaning: Median income measure for the represented housing area; scale and currency basis are not stated.

variables.name: HouseAge
variables.meaning: Age measure for housing in the represented area, expressed as a numeric value.

variables.name: AveRooms
variables.meaning: Average number of rooms for the represented area; the denominator is not stated in the file.

variables.name: AveBedrms
variables.meaning: Average number of bedrooms for the represented area; the denominator is not stated in the file.

variables.name: Population
variables.meaning: Population measure for the represented area.

variables.name: AveOccup
variables.meaning: Average occupancy measure for the represented area; its denominator is not stated.

variables.name: Latitude
variables.meaning: Latitude coordinate of the represented area.

variables.name: Longitude
variables.meaning: Longitude coordinate of the represented area.

variables.name: MedianHouseValue
variables.meaning: Median house-value measure for the represented area; currency and scale are not stated.

structure.description: Each row represents one geographically located housing-area observation rather than an individually identified dwelling.
Latitude and Longitude jointly locate the area associated with the remaining measures.

uncertainties: The geographic area definition, income scaling, house-value scaling, and denominators for the average measures are not supplied.
annotation_notes: Semantics are limited to the column labels and numeric formatting visible in train.csv.
